entries.desc: A product source file or arbitrary unknown JSON still fails scope when unacknowledged.

entries.desc: A TEST story can generate delivery-check.json and summary.json and then pass DONE without rollback repair.

entries.desc: TEST phase still rejects ordinary scope_contract_acknowledge or unrelated file expansion.

entries.desc: Manually adding an unrelated file in TEST still blocks DONE even if delivery and summary are allowed.

evidence.note: Confirms unrelated files still produce OUT_OF_SCOPE instead of being hidden by lifecycle metadata handling.

entries.desc: convergence_check skips .build and derived runtime directories during scanning.

evidence.note: Confirms .build and derived runtime directories are skipped during convergence scanning.

entries.desc: A fixture symlink loop does not crash convergence_check.

entries.desc: Ignoring derived directories does not hide real docs/story files from convergence checks.

evidence.note: Confirms derived-dir skipping does not hide real docs/requirements truth sources or real source files.

entries.desc: When scope gate fails, next-step prioritizes scope repair and does not recommend DONE.

entries.desc: When only delivery or summary is missing, session_brief still recommends the correct reviewer or summary command.

evidence.note: Confirms existing session_brief command-center hints still render normal next-step guidance when no blocking scope failure is asserted.

entries.desc: When all gates pass, session_brief may recommend DONE only after no blocking scope failure remains.
